prompt:
Analyze the following external review that has been addressed.
Identify what our INTERNAL code review should have caught
BEFORE the external reviewer found it.

## External Review Feedback


## Code Comments (with Resolutions)
- [operators/keystone/internal/controller/keystone_controller_test.go:3928] We do not want to test source code lexically. Remove this lexical test (lines 3900 - 3928)
- [operators/keystone/internal/controller/reconcile_bootstrap_test.go:790] We already test if the script is being loaded. Testing each keyword as presented here is too specific and brittle. Remove this test (lines 752-790)

## Resolution Summary
Both lexical/keyword tests called out by the reviewer were removed. In keystone_controller_test.go the `TestReconcile_DatabaseTLSOrderedBeforeDBConnectionSecret` test (which read keystone_controller.go and searched for substrings) was deleted along with the now-unused `os` import. In reconcile_bootstrap_test.go the `TestBootstrapDBSeedScript_EmbeddedContent` test (which asserted specific Python keywords inside the embedded script) was deleted; the surviving `TestBuildBootstrapJob_PreInsertScript_ParsesSSLDSNParams` already proves the embed is wired. No additional files beyond the two named by the reviewer were touched.

Extract 0-3 review improvement patterns. For each:
- name: Short, action-oriented name IN ENGLISH
- review_area: error-handling | security | testing | performance | type-safety | validation | architecture | naming | documentation
- detection_hint: How should the reviewer detect this?
- severity: BLOCKING | WARNING
- what_to_check: What exactly to check
- why_it_matters: Why it matters
- example_feedback: Original quote from the reviewer
- example_fix: What was changed

QUALITY: Only real review blindspots. No subjective style opinions.
Nothing that only a domain expert could know.
If nothing extractable: empty array.

LANGUAGE: ALL fields MUST be in English.

Response: ONLY JSON array.
